prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Shot through a heat camera: every surface is coloured by its temperature, the hottest things blazing white and yellow, warm bodies orange and red, cold walls fading through magenta to deep blue, the coldest corners icy violet-black. Every shape and detail is still a real photograph. Camera close at the height of a candle, the frame tilted. In a frozen attic, an old woman with a deeply lined face and a mole on her cheek, a grey wool shawl over her head, frost on her eyelashes, breath steaming, cups her hands round one candle flame. The candle and her breath are the only warm things: they blaze white and yellow, her face runs orange, and the whole attic around her is deep blue and icy violet-black, icicles hanging from the beams. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
